summary: During a monster-to-hero passive acid attack, mhitu.c:passiveum reaches its rn2(30) corrosion gate and calls uhitm.c:erode_armor when it returns zero. The JavaScript passiveum path records note_unported instead, so it skips the helper’s eleven rn2(5) armor-slot selections in this step and advances to the later rn2(6) acid weapon-damage gate. Repair the existing passiveum caller branch to invoke the already-implemented erode_armor with the same state and random owner.

source.branch: The AD_ACID arm of passiveum after the saved hero-form AT_NONE selection: a failed rn2(2) splash check sets tmp to zero; otherwise the damage/resistance path runs, then !rn2(30) calls erode_armor before the independent !rn2(6) acid_damage weapon check.
callers: mhitu.c:mattacku -> hitmu -> passiveum; js/mhitu.js:hitmu passes the saved pre-rehumanization monster-form snapshot to passiveum.
The selected recording reaches passiveum on the monster turn; in segment 0 step 478 its source log is rn2(30)=0, eleven rn2(5) calls from uhitm.c:erode_armor, then rn2(6) from mhitu.c:passiveum.
dependencies: uhitm.c:erode_armor is already implemented in js/uhitm.js and its void result is discarded by C; this correction wires the exact mhitu.c caller rather than claiming erode_armor or whole passiveum completion.

evidence: Saved v52 queue provenance: canonical manifest challenges/manifests/v52.json SHA-256 38c5e274ac970a16df08fb372269edc360f8c61f507020f29f71d9335ea9f29e; recording SHA-256 b1d7df3281f17772931ca7db82c869ea0c0acfae83e2065ad7b9c676290ba182; evaluation challenges/evaluations/hosted-38292091033-1-v52.json at fcfb7afe71226851b75665b753b0c2c73ceb7af4.

At zero-based segment 0 step 478, C records passiveum rn2(30)=0, then eleven rn2(5) calls from erode_armor (first is rn2(5)=4), then rn2(6)=5 at mhitu.c:2479; JavaScript replaces erode_armor with note_unported and immediately reaches its rn2(6)=0. The first screen difference appears at boundary 480.

C mhitu.c:passiveum (2435-2615) contains the source-order AD_ACID branch; C uhitm.c:erode_armor (126-183) loops over worn armor slots until the source stop rule succeeds. js/mhitu.js:passiveum has the direct placeholder at line 3431, while js/uhitm.js:erode_armor already implements the helper body.
